mapper.select: SELECT m.MATCHING_NUMBER AS matchingNumber, m.MATCHING_START AS matchingStart, m.MATCHING_STATE AS matchingState, m.MENTOR_NUMBER AS mentorNumber, m.MENTEE_NUMBER AS menteeNumber, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subjectNumber, m.PAY_ID AS payId, t1.MEMBER_NAME AS mentorName, t2.MEMBER_NAME AS menteeName, s.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, p.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, p.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, p.PAY_DATE AS payDate, p.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus FROM UB_MATCHING m JOIN UB_MEMBER t1 ON m.MENTOR_NUMBER = t1.MEMBER_NUMBER JOIN UB_MEMBER t2 ON m.MENTEE_NUMBER = t2.MEMBER_NUMBER JOIN UB_SUBJECT s ON m.SUBJECT_NUMBER = s.SUBJECT_NUMBER JOIN UB_PAY p ON m.PAY_ID = p.PAY_ID WHERE (m.MENTOR_NUMBER = #{memberNumber} OR m.MENTEE_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}) AND m.MATCHING_STATE IN ('매칭중', '요청 처리 중') ORDER BY m.MATCHING_START DESC LIMIT 1
